response.overview: During a session with his therapist, Camilo Hernández relives fragmented memories of his time as a soldier in the jungles of Vietnam. Amidst voices from the past and moments of war alongside his comrades, Camilo confronts the memories that still haunt him and the difficult task of reconciling his past with his present.
response.tagline: “Sometimes the truth isn’t the best answer”
response.title: Los Cocos
